findings.title: Header navigation links have insufficient contrast
findings.description: The 'Docs' link (element 'body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1)') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the first navigation link.

findings.title: Header navigation links have insufficient contrast
findings.description: The 'Status' link (element 'body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(2)') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the second navigation link.

findings.title: Bell icon has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The bell icon (element '#bell') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the notification icon in the header.

findings.title: Gear icon has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The gear icon (element '#gear') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the settings icon in the header.

findings.title: First paragraph has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The 'Manage your plan and invoices.' text (element 'body > main > p:nth-of-type(1)') has text contrast 2.38:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the introductory paragraph.

findings.title: Section paragraph has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The paragraph under the 'Billing' heading (element 'body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > p') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the descriptive text in section 1.

findings.title: Upgrade button has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The 'Upgrade' button (element '#upgrade') has text contrast 2.39:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the primary action button.

findings.title: Section link has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The 'Upgrade' link in section 1 (element 'body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > a') has text contrast 1.90:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the link within section 1.

findings.title: Section paragraph has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The first paragraph in section 3 (element 'body > main > section:nth-of-type(3) > p:nth-of-type(1)') has text contrast 2.10:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the 'Payment method' heading.

findings.title: Section paragraph has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The description text under 'Payment method' (element 'body > main > section:nth-of-type(3) > p:nth-of-type(2)') has text contrast 2.38:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the detailed payment description.

findings.title: Second paragraph has insufficient contrast
findings.description: The secondary paragraph (element 'body > main > p:nth-of-type(2)') has text contrast 1.90:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot as the additional explanatory text.

findings.title: Mobile content overflow in payment section
findings.description: The description text under 'Payment method' (element 'body > main > section:nth-of-type(3) > p:nth-of-type(2)') has content width 497px exceeding container width 336px, causing horizontal overflow in mobile viewports. This element is visible in the desktop screenshot but suffers overflow issues in mobile.
